notes.versioning: We follow semver: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Bump PATCH for fixes and small tweaks (v0.4.0 → v0.4.1). Bump MINOR for new features that don't break existing API contracts (v0.4.x → v0.5.0). Bump MAJOR only for breaking changes. Within a MINOR cycle, every release is a new PATCH of the current MINOR.
notes.how_to_update: Run `scripts/update-changelog.sh` from the repo root after committing your changes. The script reads your last commit message and stamps the new entry into this file. Set BUMP_TYPE=major|minor|patch to control the version (default: patch).
notes.agent_reminder: If you (an AI agent) made changes that the user can see, append to this file before committing. Run `bash scripts/check-version-bump.sh HEAD~1..HEAD` to verify your commit isn't missing a changelog bump.

entries.title: Fix ToolsStep disconnect — builder now uses real tool platform
fixes: ToolsStep in the chatbot builder was storing inline tool definitions in draft JSON (draft.tools.tools) that the runtime engine never read. Rewrote ToolsStep to fetch from GET /api/platform/chatbots/:id/tools + GET /api/platform/data-sources/:id/tools — single source of truth. Builder now shows attached tools with approval/confirmation badges, available tools to attach, approve/reject for pending tools, attach/detach via real API calls.

entries.title: Fix duplicate sidebar items (chatbots + settings)
fixes: Removed duplicate type entries in SidebarNav.tsx ClientSection union type that caused build/render issues

entries.title: Tool security: approval workflow, dangerous-action flag, table exclusion, tool-failure rule
highlights: Generated tools now start as unapproved (approved=0) — chatbot engine skips them until explicitly approved via POST /tools/:toolId/approve
Dangerous tools (DELETE/refund/cancel) auto-tagged with requires_confirmation=1 + warning in description
Schema generation now excludes security-sensitive tables (sessions, api_keys, password_resets, audit_logs, tokens, secrets)
Data-first prompt hardened: 'If a tool FAILS, tell the user the info is unavailable — NEVER answer from memory after a tool failure'

entries.title: Tool generation + tool ranking + data-first enforcement
highlights: Tool generation engine: auto-create tools from OpenAPI specs (one tool per endpoint) or database schemas (lookup + search per table). Eliminates manual tool creation — the #1 friction point

Tool ranking engine: scores each tool by relevance to the user's message (keyword matching on name, description, parameters) before sending to the LLM. Only exposes top-8 relevant tools. Reduces tokens, hallucinations, latency, cost
Data-first system prompt enforcement: every chatbot with tools now gets a mandatory CRITICAL rule — 'NEVER guess inventory, pricing, customer info, or order status. ALWAYS call the tool first.'
New CLI: fidscript tools generate --from-openapi @spec.json / --from-schema @schema.json — auto-generate + attach tools from your system's API spec
Published @fidscript/cli v1.0.8 + @fidscript/sdk v0.1.5 on npm

entries.title: CLI tool/data-source commands + Tools & Integrations docs + npm v1.0.7
highlights: New CLI commands: fidscript data-source list/create/delete, fidscript tool list/exec, fidscript chatbot tools attach/detach — all headless
New docs guide: Tools & Integrations — 6-layer architecture, tool-calling engine, e-commerce demo walkthrough, connecting real systems, agent-driven setup
Published @fidscript/cli v1.0.7 + @fidscript/sdk v0.1.4 on npm with the new tool commands

entries.title: AI Agent Tool Calling Platform — data sources, tools, workflows, execution
highlights: New 6-layer tool platform: integration_connections (encrypted credentials for external systems) → data_sources (datasets/queries) → tools (lookup/search/query/action/workflow) → tool_workflows (multi-step chains) → chatbot_tools (attach + permissions) → tool_execution_logs (full audit)

Tool-calling engine (src/modules/ai/toolCallingEngine.ts): LLM → parse tool_call tags → execute → append result → re-call LLM → loop. Max 5 iterations. Works across ALL providers (gemini/openai/anthropic) via XML-tagged format.

E-commerce demo seeded per workspace: lookup_customer_by_phone + search_products + add_to_cart + place_order. Demo data source is clearly marked as replaceable — users connect their real API via integration_connections.
toolRunner supports 5 types: lookup (key-based fetch), search (free-text filter), query (HTTP GET), action (HTTP POST/PUT/DELETE), workflow (multi-step chain calling other tools)

New API routes: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/platform/data-sources, POST /api/platform/data-sources/:id/tools/:toolId/exec (direct tool execution), GET/POST/DELETE /api/platform/chatbots/:id/tools (attach tools to chatbots)
fixes: Sandbox now gates /api/platform/* endpoints with JWT-required banner + disabled Execute

entries.title: Tier command + refresh + sandbox auth gating + WhatsApp compliance audit
highlights: New fidscript tier (alias quota) command — shows WhatsApp tier (0-4), current plan, daily unique-customer cap, this-month usage, token balance, and the speed/pacing limits; works in --json and --yaml for agent use
New fidscript refresh command — re-issues the JWT using the stored email (now saved to ~/.fidscript/credentials), interactive or headless with --code; no need to re-type your email daily
Sandbox now gates /api/platform/* endpoints with a yellow JWT-required banner + disabled Execute button when clientToken is missing — users can't accidentally fire unauthenticated chatbot calls

docs/WHATSAPP_COMPLIANCE.md — full audit of every Meta rule that applies to our system (speed ceiling 80 MPS, volume tiers, prohibited content, hallucination policy, 24h session window, idempotency), with code references + verification tests
Chatbot publish --timeout hardened: SIGTERM now handled, exit-code logic explicit (0=terminal, 2=timeout), all comments documenting the new semantics
fixes: CLI bin script now reads version from package.json via createRequire(import.meta.url) so the require() under ESM is no longer triggered

entries.title: @fidscript/cli on npm — SDK bundles the CLI; new npm install paths
highlights: Published @fidscript/cli to npm (v1.0.4) — install with: npm install -g @fidscript/cli
@fidscript/sdk now depends on @fidscript/cli — npm install @fidscript/sdk auto-pulls the fidscript binary to node_modules/.bin/
New install path docs in landing/CliInstallSection + docs/CLI.md covering npm (recommended), SDK-bundled, and the existing curl one-liner
fixes: CLI was crashing at startup under ESM because require() isn't allowed in module scope — replaced with createRequire(import.meta.url) in src/version.ts so version() works when installed as a dependency

entries.title: Per-version pages + semver discipline + agent reminder
highlights: New /changelog/:version route — each release gets its own URL (e.g. /changelog/v0.4.0) with prev/next navigation
Sticky version sidebar on the main /changelog page shows the full release list with bump-type badges (major/minor/patch)
Semver discipline in scripts/update-changelog.sh — defaults to patch bump (v0.4.0 → v0.4.1), accepts BUMP_TYPE=major|minor|patch env var, computes the next version automatically
New scripts/check-version-bump.sh — fails CI when a commit changes user-facing files (src/, server/, apps/, sdks/) without updating src/data/changelog.json
Changelog schema enriched with bumpType + tags + category fields for every entry
fixes: DocsPage 'Changelog' tab no longer shows stale June-2026 placeholder — routes through the shared ChangelogList component

entries.title: BYO LLM, chatbot admin, sandbox tests, CLI 1.0, published SDK
highlights: Published `@fidscript/sdk` to npm — TypeScript SDK with typed wrappers for all 10 message types, chatbots, LLM connections, and an escape hatch for every other endpoint.

Comprehensive `@fidscript/cli` — 24 typed subcommands covering auth, instance lifecycle, all 10 message types, full chatbot CRUD + AI config, BYO LLM management, SSE event streaming, and a generic `api` escape hatch. Headless by design (`--json`/`--yaml`/`--quiet`/`--code`).
Sandbox now exposes a Chatbot category alongside Messaging/Instance/Groups/Chats/Profile/Settings so developers can experiment with `POST /api/platform/chatbots`, AI config, and publish pipeline.

Admin dashboard: new LLM Connections view + Chatbots view for workspace admins — see all configured providers, model inventories, response-type breakdowns, and trigger configurations across every workspace.
API reference: chatbot endpoints surfaced in the public `/docs` page and the in-app Docs panel. 28 `/api/platform/chatbots/*` and 6 `/api/platform/llm-connections/*` endpoints now documented.
Bring-Your-Own-LLM guide on `/docs` — full 6-step walkthrough (list providers → create connection → test → wire to chatbot → tune generation → failover chains).
WhatsApp Meta Policy compliance guide on `/docs` — speed + volume ceilings, tier limits (250→∞), prohibited content list, FIDScript enforcement, system-prompt best practices, handoff triggers.
CLI comprehensive docs (`docs/CLI.md`) — 1500+ line scenario-driven guide covering sign-up, automation, CI integration, agent orchestration, troubleshooting, and full env-var / exit-code references.

Changelog system — every deploy now appends a timestamped, version-tagged entry to `src/data/changelog.json`. Public `/changelog` page renders it with categorized sections, dates, and links to commits.
Per-version pages — `/changelog/:version` (e.g. `/changelog/v0.4.0`) shows one release in full detail. Sidebar with version list filters the timeline.
Removed the (nonexistent) `pip install fidscript-api` lines from public docs — Python is no longer a claimed integration path; use `@fidscript/sdk` or direct HTTP.
fixes: Dark-mode conversion applied to 4 client pages (Settings, TokenStore + 7 subfiles, EndpointSidebar, EndpointDetail, ApiConsoleView, AdminApiConsole) and the 13 sandbox subfiles — same canonical palette (`#1a1915` / `#2d2813` / `#eab308`).
CLI `--timeout` flag wired for `instance watch` and `chatbot publish --watch` — exits 2 on timeout-without-terminal-state.
CLI `--confirm` flag auto-set in `--json`/`--yaml` mode for destructive commands (`instance delete`, `instance restart`, `chatbot delete`) — agents don't need to remember the flag.
CLI errors print JSON envelope on stdout (`{success:false, error:{code, message, status_code?}}`) whenever `--json` is set, making `fidscript … | jq` reliable.
